hook: Fifteen questions, no second chances. Can you score fifteen out of fifteen? Let us find out.

questions.question: In which city is the Eiffel Tower?
questions.question_speech: Question one. In which city is the Eiffel Tower? A. Lyon. B. Rome. C. Paris. D. Brussels.

questions.question: Which city is home to the Hassan II Mosque?
questions.question_speech: Question two. Which city is home to the Hassan II Mosque? A. Marrakech. B. Casablanca. C. Fez. D. Tangier.

questions.question: In which Indian city is the Taj Mahal?
questions.question_speech: Question three. In which Indian city is the Taj Mahal? A. Jaipur. B. Delhi. C. Agra. D. Mumbai.

questions.question: In which city is the Colosseum?
questions.question_speech: Question four. In which city is the Colosseum? A. Athens. B. Naples. C. Milan. D. Rome.

questions.question: Which country gave the Statue of Liberty to the United States?
questions.question_speech: Question five. Which country gave the Statue of Liberty to the United States? A. France. B. Italy. C. England. D. Spain.

questions.question: Machu Picchu is an ancient city in which country?
questions.question_speech: Question six. Machu Picchu is an ancient city in which country? A. Mexico. B. Bolivia. C. Peru. D. Chile.

questions.question: In which city is Big Ben?
questions.question_speech: Question seven. In which city is Big Ben? A. Edinburgh. B. London. C. Dublin. D. Manchester.

questions.question: In which city does the Christ the Redeemer statue stand?
questions.question_speech: Question eight. In which city does the Christ the Redeemer statue stand? A. Buenos Aires. B. Sao Paulo. C. Lima. D. Rio de Janeiro.
questions.answer_speech: D is correct, Rio de Janeiro.

questions.question: In which country are the Pyramids of Giza?
questions.question_speech: Question nine. In which country are the Pyramids of Giza? A. Egypt. B. Sudan. C. Iraq. D. Morocco.

questions.question: The Sydney Opera House is in which country?
questions.question_speech: Question ten. The Sydney Opera House is in which country? A. South Africa. B. Australia. C. New Zealand. D. Canada.

questions.question: Which city is home to the Burj Khalifa?
questions.question_speech: Question eleven. Which city is home to the Burj Khalifa? A. Doha. B. Cairo. C. Riyadh. D. Dubai.

questions.question: The ancient rose-red city of Petra is in which country?
questions.question_speech: Question twelve. The ancient rose-red city of Petra is in which country? A. Syria. B. Turkey. C. Jordan. D. Lebanon.

questions.question: Angkor Wat is a famous temple complex in which country?
questions.question_speech: Question thirteen. Angkor Wat is a famous temple complex in which country? A. Cambodia. B. Vietnam. C. Laos. D. Thailand.

questions.question: The Leaning Tower of Pisa is in which country?
questions.question_speech: Question fourteen. The Leaning Tower of Pisa is in which country? A. Portugal. B. Greece. C. Spain. D. Italy.

questions.question: Mount Rushmore, with four carved presidents, is in which US state?
questions.question_speech: Question fifteen. Mount Rushmore, with four carved presidents, is in which US state? A. Montana. B. South Dakota. C. Wyoming. D. Colorado.
